name: @nexting-ai/devices
description: Open interfaces for building physical control surfaces for AI agents.

scripts.test: npm run test:reference && npm run test:simulator && npm run test:scripts && npm run test:firmware && npm run test:multipad && npm run test:ahakey
scripts.test:multipad: cmake -S firmware/multipad -B firmware/multipad/.build && cmake --build firmware/multipad/.build --parallel && ctest --test-dir firmware/multipad/.build --output-on-failure
scripts.test:ahakey: cmake -S firmware/ahakey-x1 -B firmware/ahakey-x1/.build && cmake --build firmware/ahakey-x1/.build --parallel && ctest --test-dir firmware/ahakey-x1/.build --output-on-failure
scripts.check: npm test && npm run check:boundary && npm run check:naming
